common.readOnly: You can view this page but not change it. Changes need a configuration permission that your role does not hold.
common.notApproval: Changing a setting here is technical configuration. It is not a business approval and approves nothing.
common.reasonHint: 3 to 1000 characters. It is recorded in the audit trail.
common.reasonInvalid: Enter a reason of 3 to 1000 characters with visible text.
common.saved: Saved. The change is recorded in the audit trail.
common.secretRefNote: Credentials are references to a secret held by the platform's secret provider: a provider and a name. A secret value is never entered, stored or shown here.

audit.appendOnly: Audit events are append-only. Nobody can edit or delete them, and this page has no write action.
audit.scopeNote: You see the events of the organizations and transformations you may read. Events of a sensitive record you are not admitted to are shown without their reason and changes.
audit.recordTypeHint: Lower-case code, for example benefit or business_case.
audit.empty: No audit events match these filters.
audit.redacted: Redacted: sensitive record you are not admitted to
audit.noChanges: No field changes are recorded for this event.
audit.invalidFilter: A filter is not valid. Check the record type and action codes.

security.rateIntro: Each class allows a number of requests per minute. The values come from the server configuration and cannot be changed here.
security.uploadPolicyIntro: The file types and the size limit allowed for new evidence uploads.

uploadPolicy.isDefault: Default policy: no organization setting has been saved
uploadPolicy.allowedTypesHint: A new upload is checked by its content and its extension. Files uploaded earlier are not affected.
uploadPolicy.maxInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 25.
uploadPolicy.typesRequired: Choose at least one file type.
uploadPolicy.inlinePreviewValue: PNG, JPEG and GIF images only. Every other type, SVG included, is offered as a download.
uploadPolicy.svgNote: SVG files can be uploaded but are never previewed.

grants.intro: A grant lets one person open one sensitive benefit, business case or evidence item. Grants are created from the record's own page, in its access restriction panel.
grants.pickTransformation: Choose a transformation to see its grants.
grants.revokeDescription: The person loses access to this sensitive record at once. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
grants.revokedNote: Revoked grants stay listed for the audit trail.
grants.notApproval: A grant is an access decision. It is not a business approval.

sensitivity.title: Access restriction
sensitivity.intro: A sensitive record is hidden from people without an explicit grant. Totals still include it for everyone, labelled "Includes restricted records".
sensitivity.sensitive: Sensitive: only people with a grant can open it
sensitivity.markDescription: People without a grant will no longer see it. Its version does not change. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
sensitivity.unmarkDescription: Everyone who may read this transformation will see the record again. The reason is recorded in the audit trail.
sensitivity.cannotManage: Only the Transformation Office or an access administrator can change the restriction or grant access.
sensitivity.noGrants: Nobody has a grant for this record.
sensitivity.notMarkedForGrant: Grants apply once the record is marked sensitive.

restricted.hint: This total includes records you are not admitted to. The total is the same for every user; the individual records and values stay hidden.

preview.title: Preview
preview.noPreview: No preview is shown for this file type. Download it to open it with your own software.
preview.failed: The preview is not available for this file. Download it instead.
preview.noContent: No file has been uploaded yet.

deepLink.malformedBody: The link is incomplete or has been changed. Ask the sender for a new one.
deepLink.unsafeBody: The link does not point to a page of this application.

operations.exceptionsIntro: An exception is opened when a job or connector fails or data becomes stale. Linked KPIs keep their last known value and are labelled Stale.
operations.empty: No operational exceptions match this filter.
operations.resolvedFinal: A resolved exception is final. A new failure opens a new exception.
operations.noLinkedKpis: No KPI is linked to this exception.
operations.hiddenKpis: Linked KPIs not shown because you cannot read them: {{count}}.

serviceIdentities.intro: Each background job and connector reads data through its own service identity, never as a person. An identity reads only what its grant allows.
serviceIdentities.label: Name
serviceIdentities.declarationNote: The declaration is set by a database migration and cannot be widened here. You can narrow the grant or restore declared permissions.

identity.title: Sign-in settings
identity.readOnlyNote: These settings come from the server configuration. They are shown for review and cannot be changed here.
identity.issuerHint: A token from any other issuer or realm is refused.
identity.residual: The corporate identity provider is configured by Mobily IT. This release is verified against a local test identity provider; no connection to a live corporate provider is claimed.

storage.publicUrlsValue: Never. Evidence is always served through the application after an access check.
storage.testRequired: Test the object-store values before you save them. The server refuses to save an object-store setting that has not passed a test.
storage.earlierFiles: Files stored earlier stay where they are and remain downloadable.
storage.residual: The production object store is provided by Mobily IT. This release is tested against a local test store; no live store is claimed.

channels.inAppNote: Every notification is always written to the in-app inbox. The channels below are optional additions; when none is configured, every workflow still completes.
channels.adapterUnavailable: Enterprise messaging has no adapter in this release. It cannot be enabled.
channels.noCredentials: No sign-in to the mail server
channels.test: Send a test message to me
channels.residual: The mail server is provided by Mobily IT. This release is tested against a local test mail server; no live mail service is claimed.

deliveries.intro: One row per notification sent to an optional channel. The in-app inbox is not listed: it always receives every notification.

skipReasonValue.no_address: the person has no email address
skipReasonValue.recipient_restricted: the person may no longer see the item
skipReasonValue.recipient_disabled: the person turned this channel off
